helpers.name: EV solar controller owns session
helpers.purpose: Persistent ownership marker; only this automation may stop a session it started or adopted.

helpers.name: EV solar controller stopped session
helpers.purpose: Persistent restart latch, restored across HA restarts.

helpers.name: EV solar deficit stop pending
helpers.purpose: Persistent armed flag so an elapsed deficit timer is recovered on the next poll if HA missed timer.finished.

helpers.name: EV solar restart pending
helpers.purpose: Persistent armed flag; consume an elapsed restart timer on the next poll even if timer.finished was missed.

helpers.name: EV solar invalid-data stop pending
helpers.purpose: Persistent armed flag for bounded invalid-data grace expiration recovery.

helpers.name: EV current and power telemetry verified
helpers.purpose: Must remain off until stopped-session Current.Import/Power.Active.Import source freshness has been proven; restart and increases above 6 A require it.

helpers.name: EV solar battery charge shortfall tolerance
EV solar start confirmation pending
helpers.purpose: Persistent in-flight RemoteStart latch; prevents duplicate starts while OCPP status arrives asynchronously.

candidate_config.alias: TIMXON EV Solar Plan Handover (review candidate)
candidate_config.description: Separate reloadable daytime actuator. Requires select.garage_deye_energy_manager_daytime_ev_writer=external_automation. Never writes in manual mode or outside 07:00-21:00. Raw OCPP integer-amp profile retained. Candidate is deliberately not installed; telemetry and pending manager entity IDs require verification.

variables.ev_connected_and_owned_window: {{ daytime and external_owner and not manual and connected }}
variables.voltage_v: {{ states('sensor.evcharger_voltage') | float(0) if ev_voltage_fresh else (states('sensor.deye_grid_voltage') | float(0) if grid_voltage_fresh else 0) }}
variables.ev_w: {{ states('sensor.evcharger_power_active_import') | float(0) * 1000 if ev_power_fresh else (states('sensor.evcharger_current_import') | float(0) * voltage_v if ev_current_fresh and voltage_v > 0 else 0) }}
variables.non_ev_house_w: {{ [0, essential_w - ev_w, base_load_w] | max if (ev_power_fresh or ev_current_fresh) else [essential_w, base_load_w] | max }}
variables.site_room_a: {{ (((states('input_number.ev_solar_site_ceiling_w') | float(13500) - non_ev_house_w) / voltage_v) | int(0)) if voltage_v > 0 and essential_w >= 0 else 0 }}
variables.request_amps: {{ [32, recommended_amps, site_room_a] | min if plan_fresh and target_reachable and recommended_amps >= 6 and (ev_power_fresh or ev_current_fresh) else 6 }}
variables.house_battery_target_reached: {{ battery_soc_fresh and is_number(states('number.garage_deye_energy_manager_daily_battery_target_soc')) and states('sensor.deye_battery_soc') | float(0) >= states('number.garage_deye_energy_manager_daily_battery_target_soc') | float(100) - 0.5 }}
variables.battery_charge_shortfall: {{ battery_fresh and is_number(states('sensor.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_expected_battery_dc_power')) and expected_battery_charge_w > actual_battery_charge_w + states('input_number.ev_solar_battery_charge_shortfall_w') | float(500) }}
variables.sustained_deficit: {{ (battery_fresh and battery_w >= states('input_number.ev_solar_deficit_battery_w') | float(500)) or (grid_fresh and grid_w >= states('input_number.ev_solar_deficit_grid_w') | float(500)) or (completion_risk and battery_charge_shortfall) }}
variables.restart_qualified_now: {{ ev_connected_and_owned_window and is_state('switch.evcharger_charge_control', 'off') and is_state('input_boolean.ev_solar_start_confirmation_pending', 'off') and (is_state('input_boolean.ev_solar_controller_stopped_session', 'on') or is_state('input_boolean.ev_solar_controller_owns_session', 'off')) and ev_enabled_for_handover and plan_fresh and target_reachable and not active_target_met and ev_power_fresh and battery_fresh and grid_fresh and voltage_v > 0 and ((recommended_amps >= states('input_number.ev_solar_restart_amps') | int(8) and live_surplus_w >= states('input_number.ev_solar_restart_amps') | int(8) * voltage_v + states('input_number.ev_solar_restart_margin_w') | int(300)) or (house_battery_target_reached and recommended_amps >= 6 and live_surplus_w >= 6 * voltage_v + states('input_number.ev_solar_restart_margin_w') | int(300))) }}
